formulaBlock.normalization: No split synonym entries; packet positions = normalized ID-2 positions (23 entries).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 and no reinforcing strong anionic. Sodium Xylenesulfonate @3 (hydrotrope) and Cocamide MEA @7 (alkanolamide) are neither routes nor buffers (C3).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture; the only cationic, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @12, sits after Parfum (not prominent), with Glycol Distearate @8 as pearlizer and late Glycerin @22. No silicone, no payload lipid. Counter-signal: the late guar still gives some slip, so moderate is the neighbor.

excluded: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice @20, Avena Sativa Kernel Extract @23 (botanicals)
Linalool @16, Hexamethylindanopyran @17, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes @18, Hexyl Cinnamal @19 (fragrance)

wLine.note: Piroctone Olamine @9 is the earliest candidate: (i) SLES @2 before it; (ii) only Sodium Chloride @10 between it and the cap. No 7-entry alphabetical run.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single light cationic guar listed after Parfum, no other deposition family, effective C1 reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: one deposition family only, late (after Parfum) and light, facing moderate reset (W2 single family, no polymer floor).
weightPotential.rationale: Low: one late guar @12 against moderate C1 reset.

careDirection.limitation: Formula is active-led (Piroctone Olamine @9), not a lengths-care decision.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Recognized anti-dandruff active Piroctone Olamine @9 makes scalp_active the likely final focus if a dandruff claim appears.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction null (blind). Active present but the claim defines the path (R17.3); provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default regular; dandruffSupport supported means treatment fires if a moderate/high-graded E2 dandruff claim appears (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not_targeted whatever the positioning: CSA fails. No prominent E4 comfort route (Avena Sativa Kernel Extract @23 after Parfum) and no prominent E4 humectant/refatting route (Glycerin @22, Aloe juice not listed); MB excluded by prominent Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2.

actives: Avena Sativa Kernel Extract @23 (E4 comfort, not prominent)
formulaFacts.mildBase: excluded: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2
